summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (trout season to the day after rifle deer season) already manual. Added 50-amp at 3 of 30 electric sites (no water/sewer), 49 back-in sites to 50 ft (most 20-40), showers/flush toilets/dump, and RA's fall-2027 bridge-project reservation block as a booking note.
